```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Seismic hazard deaggregation summary at the reference rock condition Vs30 = 760 m/s: each cell reports the modal (Mw, R [km]) block — the largest percent contributor to the exceedance of the Tn spectral acceleration at return period TR — on the same aggregated (Mw, R) grid as the deaggregation heatmaps. Rows: return period TR [yr]. Columns: structural period Tn [s]."
DT <- RMwTable
if ("siteID" %in% names(DT) && exists("siteID.target", inherits = FALSE)) {
  DT <- DT[siteID %in% siteID.target]
}
if ("ID" %in% names(DT)) {
  ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
    DT,
    "RMw.qmd",
    target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
    siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target"),
    base = TRUE
  )
  DT <- DT[ID %in% ID.target]
}
Tn.target <- sort(unique(as.numeric(DT$Tn)))
TR.target <- sort(unique(as.numeric(DT$TR)))
rm(DT)
```
